visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a shot of the red and white storefront sign for '孫東寶' (Sun Dong Bao), a steakhouse in Taiwan. A man in a dark shirt and glasses is briefly seen standing outside. The setting is an urban street with bright daylight and simple storefront architecture. (2) A close-up shot follows, showing a steaming steak served on a traditional black iron sizzling plate. The steak is generously topped with dark pepper sauce and sits next to a pile of noodles and a fried egg with a runny yolk. The background shows a wooden restaurant table and a partial view of a menu. (3) A montage sequence showcases various items in the self-service buffet area. Slices of thin-crust cheese pizza are arranged on a white plate. Deep-fried foods, including French fries and onion rings, are kept warm in large metal trays. A spoon scoops through a bowl of curry with visible meat chunks and carrots, and another through a bowl of minced pork rice. (4) The man is seen in a close-up, eating vanilla soft-serve ice cream from a metal cup. He wears black-rimmed glasses and maintains a focused facial expression while tasting the dessert. The background is a clean, well-lit indoor restaurant interior. (5) A sequence displays the beverage station featuring soda dispensers with Coca-Cola and Sprite logos, a coffee machine, and a clear popcorn machine filled with white popcorn. Yellow text captions appear at the bottom of the screen throughout. (6) The final shot shows a full table layout with various side dishes, soups, and two main steak plates, followed by a poster providing the restaurant's address in Banqiao District.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 新開幕的. [Logo]: 孫東寶. (2) [Subtitle]: 孫東寶Plus大家吃過了嗎. (3) [Subtitle]: 這邊最低只要260元. (4) [Subtitle]: 就能吃到多種口味的披薩. (5) [Subtitle]: 四款炸物. (6) [Subtitle]: 撈得到牛肉塊的咖哩. (7) [Subtitle]: 肥瘦相間的滷肉飯. (8) [Subtitle]: 飲料機、咖啡機、霜淇淋機、爆米花機這裡也都有. (9) [Subtitle]: 這邊最便宜280元的排餐. (10) [Subtitle]: 有牛排、豬排、雞排可以選擇. (11) [Subtitle]: 當天我是點了七分熟的牛排. (12) [Subtitle]: 除了肉偏薄之外. (13) [Subtitle]: 味道吃起來就是常見的夜市牛排. (14) [Subtitle]: 店裡面也有提供多種醬料可以使用. (15) [Subtitle]: 排餐搭配的麵條是家常細麵. (16) [Subtitle]: 麵上面裹滿了蘑菇醬與胡椒醬. (17) [Subtitle]: 用餐限時90分鐘. (18) [Subtitle]: 整體餐點的味道我覺得是適合吃粗飽的人. (19) [Subtitle]: 不知道大家看完之後會想去試看看嗎. (20) [Subtitle]: 店家的地址我也把它放在這. [Slogan]: 新北市板橋區國慶路139號.
